name: whoami
description: Prints the effective username of the current process.

flags.description: Prints the current effective user name.

examples.explanation: You are logged in as user.
After sudo, the effective user is root — a quick way to verify that sudo works.

about: whoami is equivalent to id -un. It prints the effective UID's name, which is what matters for permission checks — inside a sudo shell it reports root even though your login name is unchanged.
useCases: Verify which account you are operating as before destructive work.
Confirm sudo/su switched you to root.
mistakes: Using whoami to check login identity over the effective identity — use logname or who for the original login.
